column1: # Reverb_x64.dll (Issue #1429): the reverb DLL of the installer's Shared folder. Sytrus loads it by its bare name (LoadLibraryW "Reverb_x64.dll", the 126 that stopped the engine

# before this row), so the key is the bare name: fle_realmod_find compares it with the normalized name. A helper (補助): a library that Sytrus loads, not a plugin of the Browser (no Plugin database entry).
